children.caption: About
children.name: about
children.text:
CyborgOS: the CPC (320K: 8 discs, Z ready-made), the ZX Spectrum Next (the NEX, its boot archive, the card) and the MSX2 (CYBORGOS.COM for MSX-DOS 2 / Nextor, its folder).
Run: every part in order; it stops where a tool outside (sjasmplus) has to run - its scripts are in the stage folder.
